BrokerTimestamp.name: x-timestamp
BrokerTimestamp.description: Request timestamp in seconds or milliseconds.

cancelOpenOrders.description: Whether to cancel open orders. Defaults to false when omitted. The current version does not cancel orders automatically.

reason.description: Reason for the operation. Defaults to an empty string when omitted.

eventEnabled.description: Whether event-level risk control is enabled. Omit it to leave the current value unchanged.

eventSlug.description: Event slug. Omit it to update only the broker's global configuration.

globalEnabled.description: Whether global broker risk control is enabled. Omit it to leave the current value unchanged.

maxEventWorstCasePayout.description: Maximum worst-case payout for one event. Omit it to leave the current value unchanged.

maxGlobalWorstCasePayout.description: Maximum global worst-case payout for the broker. Omit it to leave the current value unchanged.

brokerUserId.description: User ID in the broker system.

desc.description: User description. When omitted, it is empty for a new user.

email.description: User email address. When omitted, it is empty for a new user and unchanged for an existing user.

userName.description: User name. When omitted, it is empty for a new user and unchanged for an existing user.

domain.description: Broker domain. Omit it to leave the current value unchanged.

name.description: Broker name. Omit it to leave the current value unchanged.

webhookUrl.description: Webhook URL. Omit it to leave the current value unchanged, or send an empty string to clear it.

desc.description: New user description. Omit it or send an empty string to leave the current value unchanged.

userName.description: New user name. Omit it or send an empty string to leave the current value unchanged.
